name: OCI Enterprise AI Portal Change Log

entries.summary: Fix Responses streaming parser for structured-output demos.
changes: Responses Streaming + Structured Output now ignores reasoning deltas and aggregates only response output-text deltas.
Structured output parsing now recovers the JSON object from the streamed final output when the provider includes surrounding text.
Portal and administration assets now use version 0.0.21.

entries.summary: Add SDK-backed LangGraph/Locus runners and two OCI Generative AI API cards.
changes: LangGraph Hosted Agent + MCP now compiles a portal-side LangGraph StateGraph before live OCI synthesis, matching the hosted runtime SDK.
Locus SDK Agentic Workflows now imports Oracle Locus SDK Agent/tool symbols and builds a real SDK tool contract before OCI synthesis.
Added OpenAI-Compatible Chat Completions and Responses Streaming + Structured Output demo cards backed by the existing infra/responses-api stack.
Run-window documentation, wiring diagrams, code references, and script dispatch were updated for the new cards.
Portal and administration assets now use version 0.0.20 to bypass stale 0.0.19 browser assets.

entries.summary: Fix hosted card layout and restrict Launch-only behavior to real hosted UI demos.
changes: Only Langfuse and OpenClaw are treated as hosted UI launch-only demos.
Hosted Agentic Applications, LangGraph, A2A, and Control Tower stay as Run demos with request and response payload output.
Long hosted endpoint references are removed from card faces so Run and Flow actions remain visible.
Portal and administration assets now use version 0.0.19 to bypass stale 0.0.18 browser assets.

entries.summary: Fix hosted UI launch actions and add administration change tracking.
changes: Every hosted deployment UI demo now exposes Launch inside the run window, and UI-only hosted demos use Launch as the only visible action.
The run dialog header is limited to Documentation and OCI wiring diagram links.
Launch-only hosted demos hide prompt, model, project, and temperature fields.
Portal and administration assets include a version query string to avoid stale browser caches.
Administration includes an Object Storage-backed change log view.
Resource Manager apply deployed the hosted application infrastructure and portal runtime metadata.
Portal version shown on the login page was 0.0.17.
